requirements: Pin unchanged stock bytes and recover the remaining Drv_Init control flow through every return including transitive version DAC DDR skip-tap reset and self-test operations.

Recover offsets widths constants tables masks loops delays mutable selectors returned-state predicates and error propagation; identify the immediate upstream success or failure consumer and next subsystem boundary.
Emit a typed TOML operation graph with static-determined runtime-selected hardware-returned asynchronous and unknown classes; preserve branches and provenance rather than an unconditional transcript.

Check byte ranges bindings graph integrity and candidate operations independently of the producer; verify useful damaged inputs fail and distinguish structural verification from manual semantic review.
Correlate newly reached device ABI with existing pinned kernel or reference evidence where relevant without inferring FPGA state from mapped driver plumbing.
